title: [NEW]LIYHUB -
features:
> FULL RELEASE & FEATURE UPDATE · LIYHUB

- CHANGELOG / FEATURES:

- NEW :

> AUTO FORGE & EQUIPMENT
> • Auto Forge Weapons & Armor — Automatically forge weapons and armor whenever sufficient ores are available.
> • Auto Equip Best Gear — Automatically equip the gear with the highest power.
> • Custom Forge Ore Batch — Adjust the amount of ores used per forging batch.
> • Sell Unequipped Items — Sell all unused equipment for coins.
> • Instant Forge Actions — Manually forge weapons or armor instantly.

> AUTO COMBAT & FARMING
> • Auto Kill Enemy — Automatically target and eliminate nearby enemies.
> • Multiple Kill Methods — Choose between Instant Kill, Fast Attack Aura, or Both Combined.
> • Custom Target Priority — Prioritize the closest enemy, lowest HP, bosses, or Super Loot enemies.
> • Custom Movement Modes — Teleport, Tween, Walk To, or Stay in Place.
> • Auto Weapon Skills — Automatically activate weapon skills during combat.
> • Auto Collect Drops — Automatically collect drops after defeating enemies.
> • Kill All Enemies — Instantly eliminate all currently active enemies.

> ORE COLLECTION & MAGNET
> • Auto Collect Ores — Automatically collect ores dropped throughout the map.
> • Advanced Ore Filters — Filter ores by rarity, whitelist, blacklist, or collect all.
> • 48+ Ore Selection — Select specific ores to collect.
> • Auto Collect Enchant Stones — Automatically collect enchant stones.
> • Ore Magnet — Pull nearby ore drops toward your character.
> • Auto Return to Base — Automatically return to spawn when your ore pack is full.
> • Auto Forge When Full — Automatically forge packed ores when inventory capacity is reached.
> • Auto Claim Lost Ore Stash — Automatically claim remaining ores from the lost stash.

> AUTO TRAIN & POTIONS
> • Auto Train Power — Automatically train power with a configurable delay.
> • Training Area Selector — Select and enter training areas from Train 1 to Train 12.
> • Auto Use Potions — Automatically use Power and Luck Potions when buffs expire.
> • Custom Training Delay — Adjust the interval between training actions.

> STAGE & DUNGEON FARM
> • Auto Farm All Stages — Automatically progress through stages 1–27.
> • Selected Stage Farming — Continuously farm a specific stage.
> • Custom Stage Movement — Choose Teleport or Tween for stage navigation.
> • Auto Collect Stage Rewards — Automatically collect ore rewards after clearing stages.
> • Auto Farm Dungeon — Automatically farm Frozen Tower dungeon rounds.
> • Progressive & Selected Rounds — Choose between progressing through rounds or farming a selected round.
> • Auto Enter Dungeon — Automatically enter new dungeon rounds using tickets.
> • Auto Claim Dungeon Tickets — Automatically claim daily dungeon tickets.
> • Auto Collect Dungeon Ores — Automatically collect ores dropped inside dungeons.
> • World Boss Support — Automatically enter World Boss fights and claim rewards.

> UPGRADES & REBIRTH
> • Auto Upgrade Ore Storage — Automatically increase ore pack capacity.
> • Auto Upgrade Train Multiplier — Automatically upgrade training multipliers.
> • Auto Upgrade Forge Luck — Automatically improve forging luck.
> • Auto Rebirth — Automatically rebirth when requirements are met.
> • Auto Roll Class Luck — Automatically roll for class luck.

> REWARDS & CODES
> • Auto Claim Online Rewards — Automatically claim playtime rewards.
> • Auto Claim Offline Rewards — Automatically claim offline progress rewards.
> • Auto Claim
